candidates.editorial_decision: Make the same B travel from outcome to actor position; narrate each held result.
candidates.sample_zh: B 先出现在右边，是这轮的结果；接着回到左边，成为下一轮动手改进的助手。
candidates.sample_en: B appears on the right as this round’s result, then returns to the left to make the next improvement.

candidates.editorial_decision: Organize around what changed and who does the next round.
candidates.sample_zh: 这次谁变了？B 带着新工具。下一次谁来改？还是这个 B。
candidates.sample_en: Who changed? B has the new tool. Who makes the next change? That same B.
candidates.reason: Questions compete with the visible movement and repeat the same point.

candidates.editorial_decision: Explain as a workshop passing better equipment to its next worker.
candidates.sample_zh: 先把工具改好，再让带着新工具的助手接着干。
candidates.sample_en: Improve the tool, then let the assistant with that tool carry on.
candidates.reason: An additional workshop analogy could obscure that the assistant changes its own system.
